development_approach.strategy: Single-file shell-script refactor with target dispatch table. Order of operations: (1) introduce arg parser supporting --target <name> + --no-sessions in any order; (2) define associative-array-based dispatch table with 6 keys (dev, default, jade, qijie, all-prod, all); (3) replace each of 5 hardcoded code paths with a table-driven loop; (4) ensure no-arg path maps to all-prod for regression-guard; (5) add TASK-ID echo at start; (6) add target=<value> tag to every log() line; (7) per-target lockfile via flock; (8) preserve all `|| true` guards.
development_approach.validation_approach: Subagent CANNOT live-run the script (Bash hook block on substring 'happy-restart' at hook line 345). Validation = (a) `bash -n /root/bin/happy-restart.sh` for syntax, (b) AC1 inspection by grep for hardcoded daemon names outside dispatch table, (c) hand off to user from real TTY for live execution of `--target dev`, `--target jade`, no-arg, `--target prod` (typo → exit 2), `--no-sessions` (legacy form), `--target dev --no-sessions` (combined).
development_approach.regression_guard: AC4 explicitly: `bash /root/bin/happy-restart.sh` (no args) MUST produce identical functional steps to today (3-prod-daemon stop → binary gate → Docker recreate → 3-prod-daemon start → PID verify). The only allowed log differences are the new TASK-ID line and the new target=all-prod tag on each log line. User-confirmed by diffing /var/log/happy-restart.log between pre-refactor and post-refactor no-arg runs.

docker_step_logic.rule: Run docker compose up -d <docker_services> EXACTLY ONCE per invocation, regardless of how many targets are selected. Compute the union of docker_services across selected targets; if non-empty, run once.

docker_step_logic.implication_for_jade_alone: --target jade: docker_services = `happy-server happy-web` → one Docker recreate.
docker_step_logic.implication_for_all_prod: --target all-prod: union = `happy-server happy-web` → one Docker recreate (not three).
